features.title: Steering and .harness skeleton ship from the CLI; the kit installs itself by copy

features.evidence: Steering, templates, scaffold (config schema/README, models.json, feature schema, folder READMEs) and versions.json moved into cli/ (cli/steering, cli/scaffold, cli/versions.json; jev.md in cli/modules/jev/steering). The kit installs itself by COPY (asdd kit self): .harness/cli and .harness/steering etc. are real copies, no symlinks; only the copies are in installed-versions.json. npm package drops .harness/** and ships cli/{steering,scaffold,versions.json}. npm test exit 0: vendor check, kit self --check, install smoke (package ships cli/steering, cli/scaffold, cli/versions.json and no .harness/), lifecycle, unit 107/107; guidance asserts now bash -n each test script (a quote bug had made install.sh stop at a syntax error with exit 0 during this task; fixed and covered by guidance.test.mjs). features.title: evidence_hash replaces evidence_commit
features.user_visible_behavior: A feature becomes passing without a commit SHA; asdd sync records evidence_hash and DRIFT-02 reopens it when its scope files change.
features.evidence: evidence_commit replaced by evidence_hash: asdd sync stamps sha256 of the files scope_paths cover when a feature is passing (no commit needed), clears it when it leaves passing, drops evidence_commit. DRIFT-02 recomputes the hash (works without git); DRIFT-06 no longer asks for a SHA (scope_paths + evidence remain). scope-lib.mjs holds globs, file listing, and the hash (breaks a drift-lib -> features -> sync-state import cycle that hung asdd sync). Tests: drift-lib unit (stamp, new file, edit, unstamped, no git), lifecycle (stamp, DRIFT-02 on edit and on a file added to a passing scope, unstamp on in_progress); npm test exit 0 (109/109); spec-drift 108/108, knowledge 8/8, jev-gate 9/9 on the vendored copies. Kit migration: asdd sync stamped 35 passing features, no evidence_commit key left.
